freeze_order: DGCT v1.1 is frozen after v1 was invalidated by transfer-observer truncation and before any v1.1 model-backed outcome is generated or inspected. No field, generation, split, amplitude, or complexity parameter is changed from v1.

amendment.reason: DGCT v1 produced exactly zero transfer-observer transition energy because cumulative states preserved a long invariant prefix and all-MiniLM-L6-v2 truncated before the changing continuation. v1 remains archived as an invalid/inconclusive measurement.
amendment.scope: observation-only amendment; generated continuations and all scientific field/compression parameters are unchanged

observation.rationale: Use one identical frozen suffix window for both observers so the newest continuation is visible even to the shortest-context observer. The generator still receives the original unmodified prompt.
observation.validity_gate: Both observers must have train and held-out raw transition energy strictly above the frozen minimum; otherwise the run fails and no scientific comparison is interpreted.

trajectory_split.unit: whole generated trajectory keyed by prompt_index and generation seed

amplitude.notes: Unchanged from DGCT v1: one scalar amplitude per observer and frozen field.

complexity.notes: Unchanged from DGCT v1. No weighted scalar complexity score is primary.

claim_boundary.general_dynamic_gauge: Supported only by simpler, better-generalizing and/or more cross-model-concordant residuals under a shared frozen field; a small next-step R2 increase is insufficient.
claim_boundary.vortex_specific: Requires vortex_smooth to beat complexity-matched non-vortical controls; otherwise only a generic dynamic-gauge claim may survive.
claim_boundary.navier_stokes: Not tested in DGCT v1.1. A self-similar or Navier-Stokes-inspired field remains deferred until simpler fields earn it.
